title: 第二十三章这都没死第二十四章给你一个体面的死法
content_zh:
很快，几大凶兽王便来到了龙城附近，他们屹立于天空之下，距离有千丈之远，但却能够清楚看见龙城外面的景象。
“我滴乖乖！”
“不知道的，还以为是登天境修士在这里激战呢。”
凶牛王惊呼出声道。
“是啊，而且人家强者皆在，就连龙战都散发出了登天之威来化解刚才那股能力波动。”
“真是不可置信啊！”
凶猪王也感慨道。
“龙气还在，看来那家伙还没死。”
“或许已经被重创了。”
“即便是我们在那种程度的能量冲击之下，不死也得脱层皮！！”
凶虎王道。
它目光锋利，死死凝视着前方，试图寻找散发龙气的拥有者。
随着时间流逝。
龙家几位长老纷纷从刚才的波动中，站起身来。
除了大长老，二长老以及三长老以外，剩下几位长老，都偷偷擦拭了嘴角上刚刚流出来的鲜血。
神情也变得无比羞愧与不可思议。
要知道，放眼整个龙城，除了登天境强者以外，不可能有通天境修士能够抵挡得住他们这几位龙家长老的联手攻势，即便是龙家大长老半只脚都已经踏入了通天境也一样做不到。
就是在如此恐怖的招式联手下，他们居然还会负伤，这已经是不可思议的事情了。
按照常理，像秦风这种级别的修士，被这般可怕的招式轰击时，早已灰飞烟灭，连根毛都不会剩下。
自己等人，等不会因为爆发出来的波动而负伤。

恐怖的能量会直接将被攻击者的手段吞噬消散，这才是应该出现的画面。
“可恶！！”
“这小子，肯定已经被我们干死了。”
“就算没死，也绝对没有战斗力了。”
三长老恶狠狠道。
“没错！希望没有将他击杀吧，不然我们如何得到他体内的神龙真元？还有刚才所释放出来的神秘功法呢？”
“也不知道这家伙是从哪里学来的，居然要比我们龙家最强大的天功法还要恐怖。”
“难道真是他自创出来的？？”
二长老一边摇头，一边发出不可置信的猜想，如果秦风真能在如此年龄和境界中创造出来这般可怕的功法，那他绝对是万年难得一见的妖孽，甚至要比一些超级家族，圣地以及皇朝势力都还要恐怖。
“这杂碎，肯定已经像死狗一样躺在地上了。”
“希望还能让他留口气在！！”
“老夫定要亲手将其活剥！！”
唯有大长老还沉浸在失去独孙的愤怒之中，甚至都失去了理智。
此刻！！
所有龙城修士的目光，都落在了刚才招式之威爆发的集中点。
谁都想知道如此可怕的秦风，在那种程度的招式之威下，还有没有生还的可能性。
“爹！！”
“这家伙的功法，是我们龙家的吧？”
“他不可能能够自创出来这么可怕的功法，莫非是从龙灯里所得到的？”
身为圣女的龙云沁，倒是在此刻彰显出了智慧，站在自己老爹身后问道。

“有可能，当年我们老祖创造龙家还有龙城时，已经是东土大陆上的霸主之一了，据说都快有着踏入神界的修为，只可惜，最终还是陨落了。”
“老祖留下那头神龙雕像，并且以点亮龙灯的方式来寻找传承者，肯定不只是留下了神龙真元，必有其它传承之物。”
“秦风所施展出来的功法，大概率就是我们老祖的。”
“只是为父有一点没有想明白，明明这小子体内没有我们龙家血脉，老祖为何要将这么强大的功法还有神龙真元给他呢？”
content_en:
Soon, several ferocious beast kings arrived near Dragon City. They stood under the sky, thousands of feet away, but they could clearly see the scene outside Dragon City.
"I'll be good!"
"For those who don't know, I thought it was the Heavenly Realm monks fighting fiercely here."
The Fierce Ox King exclaimed.
"Yes, and all the powerful people are here. Even Long Zhan exuded the power of ascending to the sky to resolve the fluctuation in ability just now."
"It's unbelievable!"
The Fierce Pig King also sighed.
"The dragon energy is still there, it seems that guy is not dead yet."
"Perhaps it has been hit hard."
"Even if we are under that level of energy impact, we will still have to shed our skin if we don't die!!"
The King of Fierce Tigers.
It has sharp eyes and stares straight ahead, trying to find the owner who exudes dragon energy.
As time passes.
Several elders of the Long family stood up from the shock just now.
Except for the first elder, second elder and third elder, the remaining elders secretly wiped the blood that had just flowed from the corners of their mouths.
His expression also became extremely ashamed and incredible.
You know, looking at the entire Dragon City, except for the strong ones in the Heaven Realm, it is impossible for any monks in the Heaven Realm to be able to withstand the joint attack of these elders of the Long Family. Even if the elders of the Long Family have already stepped into the Heaven Realm with half of their feet, they can't do it.
Even with the combination of such terrifying moves, it was incredible that they would still be injured.
According to common sense, when a monk of Qin Feng's level was bombarded by such a terrifying move, he would have been reduced to ashes, with not even a hair left.
Waiting for others, you won't be injured by the burst of fluctuations.
The terrifying energy will directly devour and dissipate the attacker's means. This is what should happen.
"Damn it!!"
"This kid must have been killed by us."
"Even if he's not dead, he definitely has no fighting ability."
The third elder said fiercely.
"That's right! I hope we didn't kill him, otherwise how would we get the divine dragon essence in his body? And what about the mysterious technique that was released just now?"
"I don't know where this guy learned it from, but it's actually more terrifying than the most powerful Heavenly Technique of our Long family."
"Did he really create it himself??"
The second elder shook his head and made an unbelievable conjecture. If Qin Feng could really create such a terrifying technique at such an age and level, then he would definitely be a rare monster seen in ten thousand years, even more terrifying than some super families, holy places and dynasty forces.
"This bastard must be lying on the ground like a dead dog."
“I hope it can still give him some breathing space!!”
"I will definitely skin him alive with my own hands!!"
Only the great elder was still immersed in the anger of losing his only grandson, and even lost his mind.
now! !
The eyes of all the Dragon City monks fell on the focus point where the power of the move just erupted.
Everyone wants to know whether such a terrifying Qin Feng has any chance of surviving under the power of that level of moves.
"Dad!!"
"This guy's technique belongs to our Long family, right?"
"It's impossible for him to create such a terrifying technique on his own. Could it be that he got it from the dragon lantern?"
As a saint, Long Yunqin showed her wisdom at this moment and asked while standing behind her father.
"It's possible that when our ancestor created the Long Family and Dragon City, he was already one of the overlords on the Eastern Continent. It is said that he was almost ready to enter the divine realm. Unfortunately, he eventually fell."
"The ancestor left behind the statue of the divine dragon and lit up the dragon lantern to find the inheritor. It must not only have left behind the divine dragon essence, but also other inheritance items."
"The skills Qin Feng performed are most likely those of our ancestors."
"It's just that my father didn't understand something. It's obvious that this kid has no body in his body.Why would our ancestor of the Long family give him such a powerful technique and the divine dragon essence? "
